name: AGC-005 — URL-Shortener Redirect Chain
description: Disclosure: Executed & documented by Claude Code under direction and review by Ali. | AGC-005: Shortener URL /go/abc123 302-redirects to credential harvester /portal-login. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.

techniques.comment: AGC-005: URL shortener redirect chain. Phishing email contains /go/abc123 (benign-looking shortener URL). Server returns HTTP 302 Found with Location: /portal-login. Final destination is credential harvester (same campaign infrastructure as AGC-001-004). Chain reconstruction required to identify malicious endpoint. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.
